text:
We would be pleased to send our helicopter to your area so that we can locate and map the marijuana fields and prepare an estimate for possible action next May. There would be no charge or obligation for the initial survey or estimate.
Enclosed is a patch that might be appreciated by your volunteer workers.
I'm looking forward to arranging details of the initial survey with you Monday September 28, 1971 at 11 A.M.
Very truly yours,
John L. Clarke
Vice President
